name: State Space Basis Transformation
description: I replaced the 3-state (27 total) condition evaluating absolute differences with a 2-state (8 total) condition evaluating the parity of active edges. This destroys the surface text fingerprint of the constants '27' and '12' while mathematically preserving the exact requirement (a 3-clique). Models relying on text pattern-matching will fail, while those that genuinely evaluate the new state space will correctly deduce it still defines a triangle.
